questions.def: Future in the Past requires 'would have + past participle'.
questions.question: They assumed that he ___ the project by then.

questions.def: 'Would' expresses future intention from a past perspective.
questions.question: She said she ___ be there, but she didn't show up.

questions.def: 'Will' must change to 'would' after a past tense verb.
questions.question: He believed he will succeed, despite the odds.

questions.def: 'Had expected' shows the expectation happened before another past action.
questions.question: I ___ that the meeting would last longer.

questions.def: 'Would have' shows a past expectation that didn't happen.
questions.question: I thought she ___ been notified about the change.

questions.def: 'Would' is the correct past-tense equivalent of 'will'.
questions.question: They predicted it ___ rain the following day.

questions.def: 'Will' needs to change to 'would' to agree with past tense 'hoped'.
questions.question: She hoped that she will pass the exam easily.

questions.def: 'Had intended' shows a past intention that wasn't fulfilled.
questions.question: He ___ to call, but he forgot.

questions.def: 'Would' shows reported speech about a future action.
questions.question: He said he ___ call me later that week.

questions.def: 'Would' is used to report a future event from a past perspective.
questions.question: We believed they ___ arrive before noon.

questions.def: 'Is' must change to 'was' to match the past tense 'was certain'.
questions.question: I was certain she is going to win the race.

questions.def: 'Had promised' indicates an earlier commitment in the past.
questions.question: They ___ to help us with the move.

questions.def: 'Would' expresses future possibility in a past context.
questions.question: They thought the train ___ be delayed.

questions.def: 'Would' expresses a future reaction from a past point of view.
questions.question: She knew he ___ be angry about it.

questions.def: 'Will' should be 'would' to align with the past tense 'said'.
questions.question: He said he will be attending the conference.

questions.def: 'Had planned' indicates a past intention or arrangement.
questions.question: We ___ to visit Rome next year.

questions.def: 'Would' indicates an imagined future situation in the past.
questions.question: I imagined they ___ be living in London by now.

questions.def: 'Would have' speculates about a past action from a past viewpoint.
questions.question: She assumed he ___ have already left.

questions.def: 'Is' should be 'was' to match the past tense 'thought'.
questions.question: They thought she is arriving late anyway.

questions.def: 'Had hoped' shows a past desire or expectation.
questions.question: I ___ that the weather would improve.

questions.def: 'Would' expresses future intention reported in the past.
questions.question: He stated he ___ be finished by Friday.

questions.def: 'Would' describes a future outcome from a past perspective.
questions.question: We were sure it ___ be a success.

questions.def: 'Is' should be 'was' to agree with the past tense 'believed'.
questions.question: She believed he is going to call tonight.

questions.def: 'Had arranged' shows a prior agreement or preparation.
questions.question: They ___ to meet at the cafe.

questions.def: 'Would' expresses a past opinion about a future event.
questions.question: I thought it ___ be a good idea.

questions.def: 'Would' expresses a future prediction from a past viewpoint.
questions.question: They predicted the company ___ expand.

questions.def: 'Will' should be 'would' to match the past tense 'said'.
questions.question: He said that he will help us later.

questions.def: 'Had expected' expresses a past belief or anticipation.
questions.question: We ___ them to arrive on time.

questions.def: 'Would' expresses a past assumption about future emotions.
questions.question: She thought he ___ be pleased with the gift.

questions.def: 'Would' expresses a future possibility from a past perspective.
questions.question: I believed she ___ pass the test.
